**Job Title:** Director of Operations 
**FLSA Status:** Exempt 
**Department:** Operations 
**Location:** Parsippany NJ 
**Reports To:** VP Technical Operations

**Summary**

The Director of Operations leads and optimizes Maury Microwave’s day-to-day manufacturing and operational activities at its Parsippany, New Jersey facility. This position provides leadership across key operational functions, including Material Planning and Control, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Assembly & Test, and Shipping.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day leadership and direction for Maury Microwave’s Parsippany Operations organization, including Material Planning/Control, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Assembly & Test, and Shipping.
* Ensure effective execution of production plans and customer commitments while maintaining appropriate standards for quality, cost, safety, and delivery.
* Drive improvements in On-Time Delivery (OTD) through disciplined production planning, scheduling, material availability, capacity management, and cross-functional coordination.
* Proactively identify production constraints, material shortages, capacity issues, quality concerns, and other risks that may affect customer delivery.
* Establish, monitor, and drive meaningful operational KPIs, including On-Time Delivery, productivity, efficiency, quality, inventory, labor utilization, capacity, and other appropriate operational measures.
* Establish a consistent operating cadence for reviewing performance, identifying gaps, assigning corrective actions, and ensuring accountability for results.
* Provide regular operational performance reports and updates to the VP Technical Operations and other members of the Senior Leadership Team
* Utilize Lean manufacturing principles and structured problem-solving methodologies to improve quality, productivity, efficiency, cost, and timeliness.
* Improve production planning, scheduling, workflow, capacity management, and shop-floor visibility.
* Partner with Quality to ensure manufacturing processes consistently meet customer, regulatory, and company quality requirements.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Engineering, Business Management, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive operations and manufacturing experience, including significant leadership responsibility in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in a high-technology electronics manufacturing environment supported by precision machining capabilities strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success improving On-Time Delivery, productivity, quality, operational efficiency, and manufacturing performance.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing operations, production planning, scheduling, supply chain, inventory management, Lean principles, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to establish and manage operational KPIs and drive accountability for measurable results.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate effectively in a hands-on, fast-paced, technically complex manufacturing environment.

**Job Summary**

Responsible for providing leadership and direction to Quality team(s) to ensure quality and compliance for the applicable products and processes for assigned department(s). Develop strategy, translate into functional plans and guide execution of long-term goals.

**Job Description**

**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Direct the development of product specifications for Medline branded products; such as the testing requirements, procedures and methods for testing, inspecting or qualifying new products and suppliers.
* Partner with Supplier Audit department and Division to determine optimal Supplier relationship.
* Develop and implement strategy for the Quality department(s) based upon Quarterly Management Review.
* Prepare and deliver Customer presentations.
* Act as liaison with Senior Leadership of Divisions, Suppliers, Manufacturing, and/or Operations to ensure quality products, on time delivery, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with Suppliers, manufacturing partners and product managers in developing and implementing QA programs.
* Oversee QSR for assigned department(s) and ensure compliance as measured by FDA/ISO/internal audits.
* Management responsibilities include:
* Typically, manages through multiple Managers. Provides leadership and management to one or more major departments of an operating unit or to a department that has system-wide accountability.
* Strategic, tactical and operational planning (12 + months) for the function or department;
* Direct budgetary responsibility for one or more departments, functions or major projects/programs;
* Interpret and execute policies for departments/projects and develops;
* Recommend and implement new policies or modifications to existing policies;
Hiring staff, recommending pay increases, performing performance reviews, training and development of staff, estimating personnel needs, assigning work, meeting completion dates, interpreting and ensuring consistent application of organizational policies. 

 

**MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

**Education:**

* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or Technical Field.

**Certification / Licensure:**

* None

**Work Experience:**

* At least 7 years of experience related to the design/operation of medical device or drug combination product platforms, design controls, risk management, including working in compliance with QSR/GMP/ISO requirements or other regulated industries (21CFR 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, MDSAP, and MDR).
* At least 4 years of management experience.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:**

* Depth of technical knowledge of relevant standards and regulations (21CFR 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, MDSAP, and MDR etc.)
* Proficiency in analyzing and reporting data in order to identify issues, trends, or exceptions to drive improvement of results and find solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to control and coordinate concurrent projects, competing priorities and critical deadlines.
* Advanced level skill in Microsoft Excel (for example: using AVERAGE function, merging and centering cells, printing centered page and/or creating a pivot table).
Position requires travel up to 30% of the time for business purposes (within state, out of state and/or internationally). 

 

**PREFERRED JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

**Education:**

* None

**Certification / Licensure:**

* None

**Work Experience:**

* At least 6 years of managerial experience preferred.
* At least 8 years of related experience in Medical Device, Pharmaceutical, Food, Cosmetic, or Personal Products industries preferred.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:**

* None

Medline Industries, LP, and its subsidiaries, offer a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

$154,000.00 - $231,000.00 Annual

This role provides oversight of the Quality Management System (QMS), Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Document Control, and Inspection functions. The Senior Director will champion a culture of continuous improvement, proactive risk management, and customer-centric quality while aligning quality strategies with broader business goals.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

### **Leadership & Strategy**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the global Idex Health & Science Quality organization, including talent development, performance management, and organizational design (6 international locations)
* Serve as the designated Management Representative, ensuring the effectiveness of the QMS and alignment with business objectives
* Establish and communicate a clear quality vision and strategy across Optics and Fluidics operations

### **Quality Systems & Governance**

* Oversee and continuously improve the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and applicable regulatory requirements
* Ensure quality objectives are defined, tracked, and communicated to leadership with clear visibility into performance and risk
* Lead internal and external audit readiness and execution, ensuring timely and effective resolution of findings

### **Performance Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

* Define, implement, and monitor key quality metrics and KPIs to measure internal performance and customer outcomes
* Present quality performance insights to executive leadership and external stakeholders
* Drive a culture of Root Cause Problem Solving (RCPS) and Continuous Improvement (CI) across all functions and product lifecycles
* Lead Cost of Quality (COQ) initiatives to improve operational and financial performance

* Partner with Operations and Manufacturing Engineering to ensure quality is embedded across production processes
* Provide leadership for Quality Engineering support, addressing non-conformances through the NCMR system and driving escalation when appropriate
* Lead and oversee Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) processes, ensuring sustainable solutions to systemic issues
* Support Design for Manufacturability, Testability, and Reliability in new product introductions, transfers, and sustaining initiatives

* Drive a customer-centric quality approach aligned with performance expectations

* Lead the Material Review Board (MRB) process, managing non-conforming materials including incoming, W

The Figeac Aero Group has multiple locations across the world. Figeac Aero North America, located in Wichita, Kansas in the heart of the country, is a leading aerospace partner for detailed parts and sub-assemblies with specialization in saturation shot peening, shot peen forming, chemical processing, painting, assembly, non-destructive testing, and machining.

At Figeac Aero North America, we place a high value on our employees. Employees are given the opportunity to be a part of something special while achieving their career goals. We offer competitive compensation as a smaller company in addition to an attractive benefits package for qualified employees.

***Manufacturing Engineering Director***

***Salary****: $90,000 - $120,000*

**Experience:** 8+ years in Manufacturing Engineering discipline in Aerospace environment.

**Job Duties:**

* Responsible for coordinating and executing activities around the following: Leading technical teams in the improvement of current processes, transitioning new statements of work, being the focal point of communication between quality, operations, NC Programming and Planning.
* Monitor and enforce adherence to internal processes and standards to ensure a consistent product to the manufacturing floor.
* Collaborate with NC Programming, operations and Manufacturing Engineering on tool and fixture design.
* Review first part runs with Quality, Operations and NC Programming to verify a conforming part and acceptable manufacturing process.
* Mentoring and training of new Manufacturing Engineers/Planners.
* Interface with customer base to resolve engineering issues.
* Investigate and resolve manufacturing issues related to low profitability or excessive scrap.
* Engagement at the estimating stage on strategic packages to review engineering design and productivity concerns.
* Shop support and guidance on first article builds to ensure engineering compliance and manufacturing process design effectiveness.
* Provides planning, direction, and coordination for all technical activities while monitors performance to estimates, budgets and organization goals.
* Participates in developing organization and department goals and objectives.
* Manage and execute assigned projects to meet all project criteria on time and on budget.
* Transition Technical Phase of new work statements on time and achieve manufacturing targets.
* Be instrumental in reducing overall manufacturing costs of strategic work statements by reducing cycle times, setup, scrap, secondary operations content, raw material content and other process driven cost components.
* Enhance core competencies in complex machining and programming.
* Challenges others to develop as leaders while serving as a role model and mentor.
* Inspire coworkers to attain goals and pursue excellence.
* Recommend and implement process changes in order to improve cost, delivery, quality.
* Identifies opportunities for improvement and makes constructive suggestions for change.
* Analyze information and evaluate results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
* Leadership and Communications.
* Report progress and projects weekly to Leadership Team.
* Mitigate team conflict and communication problems.

**Education/Experience**

* A four-year Engineering degree and 8 years relative experience in an Aerospace Engineering discipline is required
* A minimum of 10 years’ experience in a Manufacturing Engineering discipline is preferred
* Extensive knowledge and experience in machining, inspection, tooling design, assembly, and lean manufacturing methodologies
* Familiarity with MRP systems and fundamentals
* Full knowledge and adherence to ITAR/EAR restrictions and responsibilities

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism and confidentiality
* Mandatory background in an aerospace or manufacturing environment required.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including interpersonal, negotiation & conflict resoluti

record.ROLE_TEXT:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shield AI is seeking a Quality Assurance to support the development and flight test of the X-BAT program. This role is heavily embedded with flight test and engineering operations and is responsible for ensuring test articles are properly configured, inspected, documented, and ready for safe and effective ground and flight testing.You will work closely with flight test, systems, design, manufacturing, test engineering, and program teams to identify and manage quality risks, resolve discrepancies, maintain configuration and traceability, and ensure test activities are executed in accordance with engineering requirements and approved processes.

What you'll do:

 - Support ground and flight test readiness, including hardware inspections, configuration verification, test article acceptance, and review of test documentation

 - Work directly with flight test and engineering teams to identify, document, and resolve hardware, configuration, process, and test discrepancies

 - Review engineering drawings, specifications, test procedures, work instructions, configuration records, and acceptance criteria

 - Ensure test articles meet applicable engineering, quality, safety, and configuration requirements before testing

 - Support execution of ground and flight test activities, including inspections, test point readiness, discrepancy resolution, and post-test evaluations

 - Manage nonconformances, test discrepancies, and quality records through appropriate containment, investigation, disposition, and corrective action

 - Lead or support root cause analysis and corrective actions for product, process, and test-related issues

 - Identify emerging quality risks and work with engineering and test teams to implement practical mitigations

 - Analyze test and quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve development and test processes

 - Support configuration management and traceability of developmental hardware, assemblies, and test articles

 - Ensure objective evidence and quality records are complete and support product and test requirements

 - Promote a culture of safety, technical rigor, accountability, and disciplined execution in developmental test operation

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, technology, quality, or related field, or equivalent experience supporting developmental test operations

 - 5+ years of experience supporting developmental and/or operational ground or flight test 

 - Experience working directly with developmental aircraft, complex aerospace hardware, or mission-critical systems

 - Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, bills of materials, test procedures, work instructions, and acceptance requirements

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced developmental test environment with changing requirements and priorities

 - Willingness to work outdoors at test ranges and travel as required

 - Overtime, evening, and weekend coverage as required by flight test operations

Preferred qualifications:

 - 10+ years of experience supporting developmental or operational flight test

 - Experience with unmanned aircraft, prototype aircraft, weapons systems, or other mission-critical aerospace systems

 - Experience with flig

**Plant Manager**

**Manufacturing Operations | Color Compounding and Synthetic Turf Yarn Extrusion**

Company

TenCate

 

Location

Dayton, Tennessee

 

Department

Manufacturing / Operations

 

Reports To

VP of Manufacturing

 

Position Type

Full-Time

**About Us**

TenCate brings together specialized businesses in synthetic turf manufacturing, sports surfacing, construction, and related services. Our operations combine manufacturing expertise, product innovation, and customer-focused execution to support high-performing athletic environments.

**Position Summary**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership and performance of the Dayton manufacturing facility, which includes color compounding and extrusion of synthetic turf yarn. This role has accountability for safe operations, product quality, production performance, cost control, staffing, maintenance coordination, continuous improvement, third-party yarn sales, and sourcing of raw materials.

The Plant Manager will provide strong day-to-day leadership while building the systems, accountability, and capabilities necessary to support future growth. The successful candidate will be a visible, hands-on leader who is comfortable working directly with production teams while also managing plant performance through data and clearly defined operating metrics.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Safety and Compliance**

* Maintain a strong safety culture with clear expectations and accountability at all levels of the plant.

* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety requirements and company standards.

* Drive identification and correction of unsafe conditions and operating practices.

**Manufacturing Operations**

* Lead daily operations across color compounding and turf-yarn extrusion.

* Ensure production schedules are achieved while maintaining safety and quality requirements.

* Optimize machine utilization, throughput, labor, and manufacturing efficiency.

* Identify and eliminate production bottlenecks, excessive downtime, scrap, and waste.

* Ensure effective shift-to-shift communication and production reporting.

* Coordinate production priorities with planning, supply chain, quality, maintenance, and other manufacturing locations.

**Quality**

* Ensure products consistently meet established specifications and customer requirements.

* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for quality issues, scrap, and customer complaints.

* Maintain strong process controls around color consistency, raw materials, extrusion conditions, and finished-yarn performance.

* Partner with Quality and Technical teams on process and product improvements.

**Cost and Productivity**

* Manage plant performance against budget and operating targets.

* Drive improvements in labor efficiency, material yield, waste, energy consumption, downtime, and overall manufacturing cost.

* Monitor plant KPIs and develop corrective actions when performance falls below target.

* Identify and execute continuous-improvement and cost-reduction opportunities.

**Commercial and Raw Material Sourcing**

* Manage third-party yarn sales, including customer coordination, pricing support, order execution, and alignment of external commitments with available plant capacity.

* Develop and maintain productive relationships with third-party yarn customers while ensuring service, quality, and profitability expectations are met.

* Lead sourcing and supplier coordination for key raw materials used in color compounding and turf-yarn extrusion.

* Partner with Supply Chain, Technical, Quality, and Finance to evaluate suppliers, material performance, cost, availability, and supply risk.

* Support negotiations, purchasing strategies, inventory planning, and contingency plans that ensure reliable and cost-effective raw material supply.

**People Leadership**

* Provide leadership and direction to supervisors, technical resources, and hourly manufacturing associates.

* Estab

As a Senior Director - Operations you will be responsible for the performance of all operational functions of a large, complex location, or multiple remote locations. You will provide strategic leadership to meet and optimize established levels of business performance objectives, service, productivity, and quality. You will partner with leaders across supply chain, operations, and the business units to drive continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Set strategic goals for operational efficiency and increased productivity.
* Lead team to ensure objectives are met, including driving customer service excellence plans, setting and managing performance targets, and employee performance management.
* Partner with Lean Leadership, ensuring LEAN methodologies are utilized and action plans are developed to correct problem areas and optimize established levels of business performance objectives, service, productivity, and quality
* Ensures consistent compliance with standard operating procedures, policies, internal audit controls, Sarbanes-Oxley controls, and business management quality system requirements
* Analyze current operational processes and performance, recommending solutions for improvement when necessary.
* Identifies market potential through competitor analysis and strategic planning.
* Develops annual business plans, identifies key activities, and priorities.
* Implements and communicates operational strategies and solutions consistent with business plans.
* Provides guidance to operations management in hiring and developing talent.
* Ensures operational excellence goals and audit requirements are met.
* Partners with inventory leaders to ensure region inventory needs and goals are met.
* Provides guidance to ensure business continuity and recovery plans are met.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree preferred
* LEAN yellow belt certification
* 10+ years of operations leadership experience
* Experience running large, complex location or multiple remote locations
* Business and management principles, including strategic planning and resource allocation.
* Strategic thinking skills and ability to work with senior management and regional teams.
* Ability to streamline and implement new structures and roles that create speed, efficiency, and support rapidly shifting business demands
* In depth knowledge of diverse business functions and principles (e.g. supply chain, finance, customer service etc.)
* Working knowledge of data analysis and performance/operation metrics
* Strong decision-making and problem solving skills.
* Strong analytical skills.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to influence and lead change in a cross-functional team environment.
* Ability to travel 25% - 50% of the time.

About Us:

Centric Brands is a leading lifestyle brand collective that designs, sources, markets and sells high quality products in multiple segments, including women’s, men’s and kid’s apparel, accessories, entertainment and beauty. Centric Brands is focused on our customers and our brands that will drive the company’s future growth. We are defined by innovation as we seize new opportunities and thrive in an environment informed by creativity and thinking that is both analytical and outside the box. Centric Brands reflects a team built on respect, for others and for the hard work it takes to achieve our goals and build our bright future together.

**Production**

From sourcing raw materials to manufacturing, order placement, pricing and quality control and getting the finished product where it needs to be, our production team is responsible for ensuring we keep our standards high and our business profitable at every step of the journey. If you are a focused, results -driven, tenacious and highly flexible team player, we’ll give you every opportunity to build a rewarding career with one of the world’s foremost major lifestyle brand collectives.

Specific Responsibilities Would Include:

Centric Brands is looking for a dynamic, creative and resourceful Vice President of Production, Soft Accessories, to join its team. This individual must be a self-starter and collaborative leader who takes initiative, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is excited to accelerate transformation across Centric Brands. The Vice President of Production, Soft Accessories, oversees all facets of global development, manufacturing and supply chain operations for cold weather accessories, including scarves, gloves, hats, beanies and related knit accessories. This leader will identify and manage the appropriate vendors and factories, negotiate manufacturing orders, and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality, profitable goods.

**Strategy & Innovation**

 

* Partner with corporate resources to achieve global production efficiencies across divisions and groups
* Lead ongoing market and competitive research to identify innovations in leather, knitwear, yarns, fibers, fabrications, construction, trims and finishing techniques. Translate relevant developments into actionable recommendations for Merchandising and Design, and maintain a current archive of yarns, materials, hardware and production techniques.

**Operations and Results**

* Oversee and continuously evaluate the approved vendor matrix for cold weather accessories, with particular focus on factories with strong technical capabilities in knit scarves, gloves (knit & leather), hats, beanies and related accessories. Review costing, capacity, quality and production standards.
* Lead high-level negotiations on yarn, material, trim and finished-goods pricing to ensure profitability. Approve final buys; oversee production from development samples through final delivery; resolve vendor non-compliance, claims and chargebacks; and coordinate customs classification requirements with Imports.
* Partner with Merchandising, Design and Sales throughout product development to ensure accurate execution of cold weather accessories, including stitch, gauge, yarn, handfeel, fit, construction, color and finishing. * Review production standards and brand consistency across categories and vendors. Oversee quality-control initiatives, including testing and corrective action plans for yarn performance, pilling, shrinkage, colorfastness, seam strength, embellishments, trims and overall product durability.
* Lead high-level troubleshooting of quality and technical issues. Guide special product development and modifications to designs, materials, stitches and constructions while protecting the intended aesthetic, performance and financial goals.

Joining Kyuden Energy Partners means you’ll be joining a team in which employees are recognized as the backbone of the company. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes a 401K and provides a range of benefit options covering your wellness needs.
 
 
At Kyuden Energy Partners, diversity, respect, and inclusion are not simply initiatives, they are a commitment from the entire organization, treating everyone with respect, valuing people’s differences, and empowering everyone to have a voice.
 
 
Kyuden Energy Partners provides operations, maintenance, management, and power support services to the US Power Generation Industry across the United States. Our team is comprised of experts from diverse backgrounds of technical fields, including power operations, engineering, asset management, as well as finance, human resources, administration, safety and environmental. With this diverse background coupled with extensive years of employee experience, we provide exceptional operations, maintenance, management, and development expertise to a variety of power assets.
 
 
Kyuden Energy Partners Corporation (KEPC) has a career opportunity for a Power Plant Manager in Homer City, PA. The successful candidate will oversee all plant operations, maintenance, and facility functions, ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation while meeting performance, uptime, and client requirements.
 
 
Job Summary
 
The Plant Manager is responsible for directing all Operations and Maintenance (O&M) activities at the plant. The Plant Manager assures that an adequate supply of manpower, tools, equipment, and spare parts are always available to provide for the safe and efficient operation of the plant. The Plant Manager assures that the plant is operated in compliance with applicable safety, environmental, and power generating requirements.
 
 
The Plant Manager determines own practices and procedures, contributing to the development of new concepts, and performing duties independently with only general directions given. Decisions are made within policy constraints. The Plant Manager encounters new and varied work situations, extremely complex in nature. This is in conjunction with Kyuden Energy Partners Corporation (KEPC) and Owner policies and with the approval of the KEPC Chief Operating Officer or KEPC Director of Ops and the Owner's site representative.
 
 
The Plant Manager is accountable for the plant's long-range planning. The Plant Manager must effectively communicate information to the Director of Operations, Plant Supervisors, and client representatives relative to the overall operations of the plant. The Plant Manager must perform duties and ensure all plant personnel are performing duties in a safe manner resulting in no accidents, in compliance with all environmental permits at all times and in compliance with the applicable NERC Standards. The Plant Manager must perform duties, and ensure all plant personnel are performing duties, in such a way to result in an optimum cost-benefit ratio.
 
 
All employees have the responsibility to both the customer and their co-workers to do the job right the first time and to ensure the customer's needs are met.
 
 
Job Functions
 

* Responsible for ensuring that all plant personnel and plant objectives are aligned with client requirements.
* Administration and compliance with plant Safety, Operations, NERC, Maintenance, Administrative, Training, Chemistry and Environmental programs and ensure the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of the plant.
* Manage and oversee the performance of planned and unplanned plant outages.
* Implement training and qualification programs to assure that plant personnel are fully qualified to operate and maintain the facility and plant procedures are understood and properly followed by all plant personnel.
* Conduct periodic reviews of plant policies and procedures to ensure that they reflect current plant operating requirements.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**Raytheon Company, Managed by Collins Aerospace**

We are seeking a dedicated professional to join our team as a Senior Manager, Program Quality Leader. This onsite role, based in El Segundo, CA will support Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT) Avionics within Mission Systems. In this role, you will lead efforts and develop teams to effectively implement Quality & Mission Assurance (QMA) requirements across all program phases. You will serve as the primary Quality interface for customers, suppliers, and programs.

**What You Will Do**:

* Develop and lead a team of Program Quality Leads (PQLs) and Customer Quality Engineers (CQEs) to support program execution and deliverables.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to establish effective relationships and influence decision-making across multiple levels within a cross-functional environment at multiple sites.
* Ensure quality requirements are integrated into program estimates and proposals and oversee their consistent application.
* Lead and oversee the implementation of Quality & Mission Assurance (QMA) requirements across all phases of assigned programs.
* Serve as the primary QMA interface for customers, suppliers, and internal program teams, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and expectations.
* Drive strategic improvements to enhance quality processes, reduce defects, and improve overall program performance.
* Oversee the development and application of quality metrics to identify root causes and implement long-term corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with industry and regulatory quality standards, including ISO 9001, AS9100, and AS9102.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including program management, operations, and engineering, to ensure process capability, product conformance, and on-time delivery.
* Manage customer interface activities, including interactions with Acquisitioned Customers and Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA).
* Support manufacturing processes by interpreting drawings, work instructions, and Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction.
* Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

**Qualifications You Must Have**:

* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and minimum 10 years of relevant experience, or an Advanced degree and minimum 7 years of relevant experience.
* Experience reviewing customer proposals and part orders for compliance risk to quality requirements, and establishing cost estimates for quality support.
* Experience leading teams in program management, quality ma

record.ROLE_TEXT:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

Join a high-impact quality engineering team supporting next-generation autonomous systems deployed in demanding operational environments. This role works closely with engineering, manufacturing, test, and field operations teams to identify product quality issues, drive root cause investigations, and improve system reliability across the product lifecycle. You will serve as a key link between field performance and engineering execution by translating operational issues into measurable product improvements.

We are seeking a Field Quality Engineer with experience supporting complex hardware systems in aerospace, defense, robotics, or related industries, including failure analysis, corrective actions, reliability tracking, and cross-functional problem solving.

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Investigate field-reported issues and drive root cause analysis across hardware, software, and integrated systems

 - Partner with engineering, manufacturing, and test teams to implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)

 - Analyze reliability and performance trends to identify systemic quality issues and improve product robustness

 - Support validation, troubleshooting, and failure reproduction efforts for fielded systems

 - Develop quality metrics, reporting, and tracking tools to improve visibility into field performance and defect trends

 - Coordinate issue resolution across cross-functional teams while ensuring timely communication and closure

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - 5+ years of experience in quality engineering, field engineering, systems integration, manufacturing quality, or related technical roles

 - Strong experience with root cause analysis, failure investigation, and corrective action implementation in complex hardware environments

 - Ability to diagnose system-level issues across mechanical, electrical, and software interfaces

 - Experience analyzing reliability data, defect trends, and operational performance metrics

 - Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to coordinate across engineering and operations teams

 - Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced development and operational environments

### **Activités**

**SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the President, C.E.O., Directs and coordinates activities of personnel at all Hutchinson Sealing Systems facilities engaged in Quality Management System to prevent or eliminate defects in new or existing products or process by performing the following duties personally or through subordinates. This position is designated as a sensitive function for quality, engineering, manufacturing, supplier, audit, compliance, and operational information, including quality performance data, customer requirements, product and process development information, audit findings, corrective actions, supplier performance records, and proprietary company information. The incumbent is responsible for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets in accordance with company policies and customer requirements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Analyzes, evaluates, and presents information concerning factors such as quality performance, production capabilities, manufacturing problems, customer quality trends, and quality planning of new products for consideration by other members of the management team.
* Presents and evaluates alternative methods and procedures to establish standardized quality systems based on best practices.
* Participates with other top management personnel in formulating and establishing company policies, operating procedures, and goals.
* Participates in review of product development activities and APQP milestones.
* Conducts Quality System Management review meetings with top management to assess performance and compliance to customer quality requirements.
* Reviews technical problems and procedures of departments and recommends solutions to problems or changes in procedures.
* Confers with engineers and managers about quality assurance of new products and process to improve manufacturing capability.
* Reviews technical publications, articles, and abstracts to stay abreast of technical and quality system developments in industry.
* Travel required on a frequent basis to suppliers and customer facilities as well as other Hutchinson facilities.
* Provides internal quality system audit of Hutchinson Sealing Systems locations.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

Master's degree (M.A.) or equivalent; or four to ten years’ related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Qualifications may be waived by management. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:**

None.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Manages subordinates in department. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of this unit. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complains and resolving problems.

**TEAM SKILLS:**

Hutchinson is built around teamwork. This position requires the use of good team skills such as cooperation, information sharing, task sharing, timely completion of assignments, good listening and communication skills and overall respect for other team members.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community. Ability to write speeches and articles fo

record.ROLE_TEXT:
**Allied Air Enterprises** is a division of Lennox International. We bring together the collective strengths of seven comfort brands – Armstrong Air, AirEase, Concord, Ducane, Allied, Allied Commercial and Magic-Pak to give distributors and dealers the ultimate source for heating and cooling solutions. From compact residential applications to large commercial projects, Allied Aire Enterprises redefines ease-of-business through breadth of product, resources and competencies unparalleled in the market.

**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.

The Plant Quality Assurance Senior Manager is responsible for developing and implementing quality policies and procedures to ensure production meets established standards. This role leads the quality function at the plant level, driving continuous improvement, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the development and execution of quality assurance protocols and testing models.
* Oversee sampling procedures, techniques, and equipment to ensure consistency and accuracy.
* Design and implement methods to maintain quality throughout the production lifecycle.
* Manage ongoing inspection, testing, analysis, and resolution processes to uphold quality standards.
* Identify quality variances and recommend corrective actions to maintain compliance with specifications.
* Ensure timely and cost-effective completion of quality-related projects.
* Lead and develop the Quality team, focusing on talent development, performance management, and succession planning.
* Collaborate with customers to define and resolve product quality issues and develop cost-effective quality programs.
* Review product designs and recommend specification revisions to enhance quality and manufacturability.
* Develop and execute quality management strategies aligned with short-term business goals and long-term objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Six Sigma, SPC, and other statistical methodologies.
* Oversee calibration systems and repair depot operations for gauges, fixtures, instruments, and tooling.
* Maintain strong supplier relationships to ensure quality standards are met across the supply chain.
* Champion a culture of quality and employee engagement across all levels of the organization.

### **Qualifications:**

* Requires a Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related industrial field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality management, preferably in assembly processes.
* At least 3 years of direct management experience.
* Extensive knowledge of quality systems, policies, and procedures.
* Proven expertise in statistical analysis, SPC, DOE, root cause analysis, and data-driven problem solving.
* Demonstrated ability to present quality initiatives and solutions using ROI and business modeling.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and persuasion skills.
* Excellent organizational and computer skills.
* Effective leadership and people management capabilities.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to gain employee buy-in and foster collaboration.

**Other Work Requirements**

* This is an on-site role based in Orangeburg, SC (This position is 100% onsite)
